Targeted gix-object/gix-ref inventory inspected this run: 205 crate paths; 114 test/fixture paths; 37 Rust integration test source files under tests/; 77 fixture paths; 296 Rust #[test] attributes under targeted object/ref src+tests paths; 25 gix-object tree behavior #[test] attributes. Focused gix-credentials inventory: the full credentials integration target passed 50/50 tests; prompt fallback inspected 18 focused prompt/cascade call sites, and native prompt behavior is mapped. Focused gix-pack thin-pack repair inventory: selected bundle/input/output source and input test paths; upstream data::input::lookup_ref_delta_objects passed 4/4 filtered tests; native thin-pack repair behavior is mapped. The rest of the focused object/ref/protocol/transport/merge inventory remains recorded in lanes/gitoxide/notes/upstream-inventory.md.

inventory.method: shallow filtered sparse/no-checkout upstream cache using git ls-tree plus targeted git show/git grep reads only

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native PHP gitoxide slices cover loose objects, commits/tags/trees, refs and transactions, pack/index/object database, protocol fetch/push, transports, partial/sparse clone, recursive tree/blob merges, credential helper context/cascade/program behavior, and thin-pack external-base repair. The latest slice maps gix-pack thin REF_DELTA repair: ordinary reads still reject missing in-pack bases, explicit external-base reads resolve thin targets including OFS_DELTA chains whose base is an external-backed REF_DELTA, missing or mismatched bases are rejected, and repairThinPack injects external bases before rewriting the payload as a complete non-thin pack.

wordpressScenario: Git-backed WordPress content workflows, package installs, Playground snapshots, and server-side repo primitives. Current examples cover deploy-tree inspection, ref parsing/classification, protocol fetch/push flows, pack/object database traversal, partial clone/promisor hydration, sparse checkout, recursive tree/blob merges, index/worktree conflict materialization, transport boundaries, annotated release-tag provenance, credential helper context/cascade/program preflight, credential prompt fallback, and thin WordPress content-pack repair using an existing base blob without invoking git index-pack.
